provenance.operatorDescription: Grafts the real financial-result judicialResult, then rewrites its financial-imposition prompt value to a decimal edge case — keeping the producer's currency-string shape.
provenance.operatorRationale: ResultDataMapper.js:27-31 copies `prompt.value` into `resultData.amount` verbatim. It is a String on the wire: every isFinancialImposition prompt in every real fixture carries a currency-formatted string such as "£188.00". A Java port that parses it to BigDecimal and re-renders will silently turn "£1.0" into "£1.00", "£0" into "£0.00", and will lose digits past double precision. Each variant pins one of those. Since no real HEARING fixture carries a financial-imposition prompt, this operator first grafts the real judicialResult-with-financialResult.json (see graft-judicial-result) and only then edits its value.
